emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: Thank you for applying for Product Designer. We have received your application.

emails.subject: Meet the design team
emails.body: We loved your portfolio. Please choose a time for your interview with our design lead.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: Thank you for applying. Our team will review your application shortly.

emails.subject: Your employment offer
emails.body: We are pleased to offer you the Frontend Engineer position. The offer letter is attached for review. We never ask applicants to pay training fees.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: We have received your application for UX Researcher.

emails.subject: An update on your application
emails.body: Unfortunately, we have decided to move forward with other candidates. Thank you for your time.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: Thanks for applying for Product Designer. Your application is with our hiring team.

emails.subject: Next step: interview
emails.body: We would like to invite you to an interview. Please reply with your availability.

emails.subject: Thanks for applying
emails.body: Your application is in. Our team will be in touch after reviewing your experience.

emails.subject: Application confirmation
emails.body: Thank you for applying. We have received your application and will be in touch.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: Your application has been received. Thank you for your interest in our team.

emails.subject: Let us meet
emails.body: We would like to schedule a screening call to discuss your experience. Are you free on Tuesday?

emails.subject: Immediate job offer — action required
emails.body: Congratulations! No interview required. Pay a refundable training fee of INR 4,500 today to secure your role. This offer expires in two hours.

emails.subject: Your offer is ready
emails.body: We are pleased to offer you a position. Reply with your passport and bank account details by email to activate your employee profile.

emails.subject: Welcome to the team
emails.body: Your job offer is approved. Deposit the check we send you and transfer the remaining money to our equipment supplier.

emails.subject: Thank you for your interest
emails.body: Unfortunately, you were not selected for this role. We appreciate the time you invested.

emails.subject: We have your application
emails.body: Your application has been received. We look forward to learning more about you.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: Thank you for applying. Your application is now under review.

emails.subject: Application confirmation
emails.body: We have received your application. The hiring team will review it shortly.

emails.subject: Technical round invitation
emails.body: We would like to invite you to a technical round with our product team. Please select a time for your interview.
